limitations: The report covers all 13,676 entries in the XboxRecomp split manifest; a separate refined detector inventory contains 16,598 candidates.
Candidate ranges are heuristic and include overlaps; they are not a proven complete original linked-unit inventory.
All objdiff report units are explicitly incomplete. The exact-byte metric is not whole-game completion.
The 86 base objects were compiled locally from manual C reconstructions; target/base objects and source C remain local.
